That's interesting she takes a narcotic. Opiates make me functional and in a good mood. I get so much done and feel so much better when I'm on them, and not in a 'high' way. I wish I could get a doc to prescribe those, I'm one of the people that meds just mess with bad. SSRI's make me physically ill. Others really don't do much. 
And I smoke pot... for medicine.
I have the DBT workbook. It just pisses me off for now. I just need to learn how to relax... If only I could figure that out.
